name: Usage Statistics
description: Token usage and cost for PI-Desktop and the Pi CLI in one local panel, with the two sources kept apart.
author: Techd81

en.name: Usage Statistics
en.description: Token usage and cost for PI-Desktop and the Pi CLI in one local panel, with the two sources kept apart.
en.safetyNotes: Reads the two local session directories with Node's own filesystem API (~/.pi-desktop/sessions and ~/.pi/agent/sessions) and keeps its cache inside its own plugin data directory. desktop.control is declared for three read-only catalogue operations only (providers/list, session/list, project/list) so provider names and project paths can be shown; no session, agent or project write operation is ever called, and every enrichment failure degrades to placeholders instead of affecting the counts. No network access, no telemetry, no clipboard, no shell.

zh-CN.name: 用量统计
zh-CN.description: 在同一个本地面板里查看 PI-Desktop 与 Pi CLI 的 token 用量与费用，两侧来源分开统计。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 用 Node 自带的文件接口只读两个本地会话目录（~/.pi-desktop/sessions 与 ~/.pi/agent/sessions），缓存只写本插件自己的数据目录。声明 desktop.control 只为三个只读目录操作（providers/list、session/list、project/list），用于显示供应商名称与项目路径；绝不调用任何会话、Agent 或项目写入操作，富化失败只会退化成占位显示，不影响统计数字。无网络访问、无遥测、不读写剪贴板、不调用 shell。

safetyNotes: Reads two local session directories read-only and caches derived numbers in its own plugin data directory. desktop.control is used only for providers/list, session/list and project/list; nothing is written back to the host, nothing leaves the machine.
